---
name: Feature or heuristic request
about: Suggest a check, a source pattern, or an improvement
labels: enhancement
---

**What manipulation pattern or problem does this address?**
Describe the pattern (e.g. a content-farm trick, a framing technique, a source
type that should be flagged) or the missing capability.

**Evidence that it happens**
Link one or more real examples if you can (an article, a study, a news report).
This project prioritizes patterns that are documented, not hypothetical.

**Which languages/sites does it affect?**
Heuristics must be multilingual — say if your pattern is Arabic/English/other.

**Proposed detection (optional)**
Regex, DOM signal, prompt change… note that every heuristic needs a test with
positive AND negative cases (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Is it cross-partisan?**
Confirm the check would fire identically no matter which side of a dispute
uses the technique.
